description: This file defines classes and functions for traversing and serializing HTML/XML DOM trees, including a TreeWalker base class and a NonRecursiveTreeWalker implementation, with utility functions for node processing.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.description: Base class for traversing DOM trees, providing methods for handling different node types and generating serialized representations.

classes.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker
classes.description: Subclass of TreeWalker that implements non-recursive tree traversal using external node detail methods.

methods.name: to_text
methods.description: Converts input to text type, handling None values based on parameter.

methods.name: is_text_or_none
methods.description: Checks if a string is None or of string type.

methods.name: TreeWalker.__init__
methods.description: Initializes TreeWalker with a DOM tree.

methods.name: TreeWalker.error
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representing a serialization error message.

methods.name: TreeWalker.emptyTag
methods.description: Generates a representation for an empty (void) HTML/XML tag.

methods.name: TreeWalker.startTag
methods.description: Generates a representation for a start tag with attributes.

methods.name: TreeWalker.endTag
methods.description: Generates a representation for an end tag.

methods.name: TreeWalker.text
methods.description: Processes text data into tokens, handling whitespace.

methods.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker.getNodeDetails
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve node details.

methods.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker.getFirstChild
methods.description: Abstract method to get the first child of a node.

methods.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker.getNextSibling
methods.description: Abstract method to get the next sibling of a node.

methods.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker.getParentNode
methods.description: Abstract method to get the parent node.

methods.name: NonRecursiveTreeWalker.__iter__
methods.description: Implements non-recursive traversal of the DOM tree.
